venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.narrative: **CCATL — Saturday 8/8.** MOD Jk. Net $10,064 vs $7,185 target (+40.1%). Food $588, events $0. Comps $194. 345 guests / $29.17 check avg. A great Saturday despite the threat of rain — every booth and bar top filled by 7pm, quick lull ~8pm then consistent through the night. DJ on at 9pm; lively all the way to close, one of the busier Saturdays. Kitchen smooth. 86'd: Woodford Rye, Grey Whale, Don Julio, Ocho Repo, Crown. No incidents; no-shows not charged. Favorite moment: farewell to one of the bar's first regulars, moving to NY to be a lawyer. Entered by Mya.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Saturday 8/8.** MOD MD/KE & Chef JMS. Net $12,078 vs $11,658 target (+3.6%). Food $332. Comps $102.10 (0.8%; DNL, manager, spill, investor, industry, employee, tasting, F&F, Neuhoff resident). ~411 guests / $29.39 check avg. Thunderstorms 4-6pm didn't deter foot traffic. $2,300 by 7pm, then long range of intermittent pops all night; regular Saturday crowd. Birthday party res had a great time. Kitchen: decent food sales, sporadic orders; JMS held down BOH. No incidents. Entered by JO.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR — Saturday 8/8.** AM MJH & Josh; PM Carey & Lucas. Net incl events $27,538.20 vs $17,439 target (+57.9%). DC/AM $1,656, D&C PM $20,434.20, Garden/6A $6,630.06; food incl events $6,676.80; event sales $5,448 (event food $2,788). Comps $365.49 (1.65%). 375 guests (Tock). Super busy night, team hustling everywhere — Maggie in the Garden, Carey on the floor, Evan in expo. Garden busy with strong start, quick falloff ~8pm. Events: surprise 40th b-day for Nick Hobson, 35 guests in suite 6a 7-11pm — taco bar spread by Lucas W, Grateful Dead carrot cake; Justice & Madi crushed service. Big numbers with super low comps. No incidents; no-shows charged. Entered by Carey.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV — Saturday 8/8.** MOD Kyler & Chef Steves. Net $8,058; target field mis-typed in report ('7400777') so vs-target not computable. Food $814, beverage $7,237. Comps $134.30. 225 covers / $36 check avg; 8 large parties, 6 solos, 8 investor cocktails. Room built on a smooth trajectory with bumps on heavy turns, light close. James went beast mode on service. Top sellers: Rosalie, Burner Phone, Shinebox. Kitchen: early pops. Menu count 18/21, none lost. Breakage: 1 fizz, 3 DOF, 1 N&N. No-shows not charged. Entered by Thomas.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **LA — Saturday 8/8.** MOD Gigi + Josh + Josh + Saleh. Net $12,820 vs $11,516 target (+11.3%). Food $2,152. Standing Room $3,273, Marquee $9,547. Comps $645 (Bird, lots of investors, birthday, anniversaries, DNL, service recovery). 350 guests. Very busy Saturday start to finish — 151 covers on the books with lots of large parties; huge push 8-9pm (~$3.5k in that hour), possibly one of the busiest nights ever. Kitchen got hit hard with hefty wait times but the team crushed it; burned and turned all night to keep both rooms full. Strong presence to the end, filling Marquee one last time from Standing Room. No incidents; no-shows charged. Entered by Jos.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.narrative: **MG — Saturday 8/8.** AM Sam & Justin/Lex; PM Braden & Justin/Marcus. Net $15,661 vs $13,500 target (+16.0%). Municipal Bar AM $2,253 (68 guests) / PM $12,985 (243 guests); Sun Club $956; Hot Eye $2,690. Food $3,505. Comps $306. Quiet early morning, picked up ~1pm through brunch. At 3pm a walk-in bachelor party of ~40-50 hit right at Happy Hour — Carla Davis tackled it practically solo; they stayed 3:30-7pm, rolling straight into the reservation rush, reminiscent of late Fall 2025. Room bumpin' all evening; most left ~10:45 and migrated to Hot Eye, which was full with wedding party + bachelorettes until lights on. Sun Club steady from 3-4pm with two large parties; spritz top seller. Kitchen picked up ~7, no 86s. No incidents. Entered by Alexis.
